note: Set A gives six clean, correctly bound claims (design-point and optimal TSR/pitch, 4° pitch limit, 90 m force peak) with faithful quotes and no duplication. Set B covers a few extra facts (torque saturation in Region 3, pitches-to-feather, outboard 5% drop, tip deflection/tower clearance constraint) but is padded with many duplicate claims and several misbindings: 'blade peak location' and especially 'peak deflection location = 90 m' misstate a force peak as a deflection peak, and the 'design point pitch' claim uses a fabricated quote and binds the blade's design point to the rotor. The extra correct claims in B do not offset these errors and redundancy.
